# Excel formulas (AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build_workbook.py — do not edit by hand)

Paste each into the FIRST data row of the column; Excel tables auto-fill the whole column.

## Roster → Key

```
=TRIM([@StudentName])&" ("&UPPER(TRIM([@SchoolCode]))&") "&UPPER([@Subject])&[@Class]
```

## Roster → CentreClass

```
=LEFT([@Day],3)&" | "&TRIM([@Centre])&" | C"&[@Class]
```

## Roster → AbsentToday

```
=IF([@Day]<>TEXT(TODAY(),"dddd"),0,SUMPRODUCT((TEXT(Subs[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(Subs[Type]="Absent")*(Subs[CentreClass]=[@CentreClass])*(Subs[Subject]=[@Subject])*ISNUMBER(FIND(","&[@Key]&",",","&SUBSTITUTE(Subs[Students],", ",",")&","))))
```

## Roster → LateToday

```
=IF([@Day]<>TEXT(TODAY(),"dddd"),0,SUMPRODUCT((TEXT(Subs[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(Subs[Type]="Late")*ISNUMBER(FIND(","&[@Key]&",",","&SUBSTITUTE(Subs[Students],", ",",")&","))))
```

## Roster → Status

```
=IF([@AbsentToday]>0,IF([@LateToday]>0,"ARRIVED LATE","MISSING"),IF([@LateToday]>0,"LATE (not flagged)",""))
```

## Roster → FlaggedAt

```
=IF([@AbsentToday]=0,"",LOOKUP(2,1/((TEXT(Subs[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(Subs[Type]="Absent")*(Subs[CentreClass]=[@CentreClass])*(Subs[Subject]=[@Subject])*ISNUMBER(FIND(","&[@Key]&",",","&SUBSTITUTE(Subs[Students],", ",",")&","))),Subs[SubmittedAt]))
```

## Roster → LateReason

```
=IF([@LateToday]=0,"",LOOKUP(2,1/((TEXT(Subs[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(Subs[Type]="Late")*ISNUMBER(FIND(","&[@Key]&",",","&SUBSTITUTE(Subs[Students],", ",",")&","))),Subs[Reason]))
```

## Roster → HROutcome

```
=IF([@Status]="","",IFERROR(LOOKUP(2,1/((TEXT(CallLog[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(CallLog[StudentKey]=[@Key])),CallLog[Outcome]),""))
```

## Schedule → Submitted

```
=IF([@Day]<>TEXT(TODAY(),"dddd"),"",IF(SUMPRODUCT((TEXT(Subs[Date],"yyyy-mm-dd")=TEXT(TODAY(),"yyyy-mm-dd"))*(Subs[Type]="Absent")*(Subs[CentreClass]=[@CentreClass])*(Subs[Subject]=[@Subject]))>0,"Yes","PENDING"))
```

## Summary → Value (PendingCount)

```
=COUNTIF(Schedule[Submitted],"PENDING")
```

## Summary → Value (PendingList)

```
=IF(COUNTIF(Schedule[Submitted],"PENDING")=0,"None",TEXTJOIN(CHAR(10),TRUE,FILTER(Schedule[CentreClass]&" | "&Schedule[Subject],Schedule[Submitted]="PENDING")))
```

## Summary → Value (MissingCount)

```
=COUNTIF(Roster[Status],"MISSING")
```

## Summary → Value (ArrivedLateCount)

```
=COUNTIF(Roster[Status],"ARRIVED LATE")
```

## Summary → Value (UnresolvedCount)

```
=SUMPRODUCT((Roster[Status]="MISSING")*NOT(ISNUMBER(MATCH(Roster[HROutcome],{"Located - at home school","Located - at home","Absent - valid reason (MC/leave)"},0))))
```

## Summary → Value (MissingList)

```
=IF(COUNTIF(Roster[Status],"MISSING")=0,"None",TEXTJOIN(CHAR(10),TRUE,FILTER(Roster[StudentName]&" | "&Roster[HomeSchool]&" | TDC "&Roster[TDCName]&" "&Roster[TDCPhone]&" | "&Roster[CentreClass]&" "&Roster[Subject],Roster[Status]="MISSING")))
```

## HR View → A2 (spill)

```
=IFERROR(SORT(FILTER(HSTACK(Roster[Status],Roster[FlaggedAt],Roster[StudentName],Roster[HomeSchool],Roster[TDCName],Roster[TDCPhone],Roster[CentreClass],Roster[Subject],Roster[LateReason],Roster[HROutcome],Roster[Key]),Roster[Status]<>""),{1,2},{-1,1}),"No absentees reported yet")
```
